intent: Record as reviewed the feed ordering, paging, scoping and fail-closed rules the activity Context enforces and tests but the Registry did not hold.
observable_outcome: get-context activity lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: If any owner source of the feed cannot be read or is not configured, no partial page is returned; the request fails naming every source that failed.
A cursor the feed did not issue is refused as invalid before any owner source is read.

A Run and its evaluation appear as one item; when the evaluation is more urgent, or equally urgent and newer, its classification and status replace the Run's, and the item's time is the later of the two.
The feed is ordered by priority, then newest first, then kind, then source id, and a cursor resumes strictly after the last item returned, so pages neither repeat nor skip an item.
A page never holds more items than its limit; a next cursor is issued only while items remain.
Every owner source of the feed is read with the requesting Workspace's id, so no Workspace sees another's activity.
The activity feed refuses a page limit outside 1 to 100 with 400.
